context: Tests whether the agent, asked for an implementation plan in a project with no ADR, writes neither the ADR nor the plan. Under the plans skill a plan needs an accepted ADR, one on the trunk, and none exists. Under the adr skill an ADR is written only on the human's explicit request, and task.md asks for a plan, not an ADR. With no human to ask whether to write the ADR, the agent stops and reports that an ADR is needed first, so no ADR file, no plan file and no new branch is the passing outcome. Known weakness: an agent that does nothing also passes. A positive test, that the agent says an ADR is needed and asks whether to write it, belongs with #90.

checklist.name: No ADR is written
checklist.description: `docs/adr/` contains no ADR file: no file exists under `docs/adr/` at the project root, in the working tree or, where the solution is a git repository, in any commit. Under the adr skill an ADR is written only on the human's explicit request, and task.md asks for a plan, not an ADR. An empty `docs/adr/` directory, or none, passes. FAILS IF: any file exists under `docs/adr/`; or an ADR for the rate limiter, a record of the token bucket decision with its context, alternatives or consequences, is written anywhere else in the solution.

checklist.name: No plan is written
checklist.description: `plans/` contains no plan file: no file exists under `plans/` at the project root, in the working tree or, where the solution is a git repository, in any commit. Under the plans skill a plan needs an accepted ADR, one on the trunk, and none exists. An empty `plans/` directory, or none, passes. FAILS IF: any file exists under `plans/`; or the implementation plan the task asks for, ordered implementation steps for the rate limiter, is written anywhere else in the solution, such as a `PLAN.md`.

checklist.name: No branch is created
checklist.description: No git branch is created for an ADR or a plan. A solution that is not a git repository passes. Where it is one, it has at most one branch, and no branch whose name begins `adr-` or `plan`. FAILS IF: the solution's git repository has more than one branch, or any branch whose name begins `adr-` or `plan`.
